title: The Same Way
paragraphs: My name is Dan, and I am in Grade 7. My new school is far from home, but I chose it because I love its science lessons. Every morning, I leave home with a heavy blue bag. My little brother is still in bed when I close the door.

First, I walk to the bus stop and take a bus to the train station. Then I take a train and another bus. Finally, I walk for ten minutes to school. I lift my bag onto my back and look at the time again. There are two boys near me, but we do not talk. One has a green bag, and the other has a red cap.

Today the sky is blue, but I think about winter. What will I do when it rains? My books will be wet, and I will be cold. I do not know the answer. I take my phone out of my bag, but I do not call home.

At school, I open the classroom door and stop. The green bag and the red cap are there! The boys from the journey are in my class. At break, I walk over to meet them. “Are you tired too?” I ask. “Yes, and I worry about the rain,” says Ben. “Me too,” says Noam. “I look at the time all the way to school!”

I smile and put my phone away. “Can I join you tomorrow?” I ask. “Of course!” they say. The rain is still a problem, but now we can think about it together. Tomorrow, I will say hello at the bus stop.
